findings.title: TableWidgetVisualization wired up with hardcoded empty columns and empty tableData
findings.body: In `tableResultComponent`, when the `use-table-widget-visualization` feature flag is enabled, the new `TableWidgetVisualization` is rendered with `columns={[]}` and a `tableData` object whose `data` is `[]` and whose `meta.fields`/`meta.units` are empty objects. The actual query results (`result.data`, `result.meta`, `fields`) are never passed in, so any organization with this flag enabled will see completely blank table widgets on dashboards instead of their data. This looks like scaffolding that was committed prematurely; the flag branch should either be removed from this PR or actually populated from the query result.

findings.title: Chronological merge compares error event timestamps against segment event timestamps with a silent 0 default
findings.body: In `gen_request_data`, the code interleaves error log messages with breadcrumb log messages by comparing `error_events[error_idx]['timestamp'] < event.get('timestamp', 0)`. Segment events that lack a `timestamp` key default to 0, which causes all remaining error messages to be flushed before those events regardless of when the errors actually occurred, silently corrupting the chronological ordering sent to Seer. Additionally, the two timestamp sources (nodestore event `timestamp` and recording-segment event `timestamp`) are assumed to be on the same clock/units; if they differ, the merged ordering will be wrong. At minimum, events without a timestamp should be handled explicitly instead of defaulting to 0.

findings.title: Mutual-exclusion validation uses truthiness so age=0 or timestamp=0 bypasses the check
findings.body: `validate_timestamp` checks `self.initial_data.get('age')` and `validate_age` checks `self.initial_data.get('timestamp')`. Both `age` and `timestamp` are integers where 0 is a legitimate value (age of 0 milliseconds, epoch timestamp 0). A report containing both `timestamp` and `age: 0` (or `timestamp: 0` and `age`) will pass validation even though the spec says they are mutually exclusive, because `0` is falsy. The check should test key presence (`'age' in self.initial_data`) rather than truthiness.

findings.title: get_environment_info performs a recommended-event lookup per issue when building PR comments
findings.body: `get_environment_info` calls `issue.get_recommended_event()` for every issue in the merged-PR comment list (up to 5 issues per comment, run for each PR on each deployment). Each call hits the eventstore/nodestore, so generating one comment issues a sequence of per-issue queries inline in the PR comment task. If the recommended event lookup is expensive or times out, comment delivery is delayed (the broad `except Exception` also masks real failures by design, so problems will be invisible). Consider batching the event fetches or using a cheaper source of the environment.
